xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4465: pan tell should accept conversation numbers and /conv/<n> URLs; error message should list them

plan.title: pan tell should accept conversation numbers and /conv/<n> URLs; error message should list them
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan tell, pause, unpause, untroubled and kill only accept issue IDs and agent IDs. Operators know conversations by their dashboard number (/conv/2972), so `pan tell 2972` fails with an error that never mentions conversations, and agents must query /api/conversations to map the number to conv-YYYYMMDD-NNNN. A successful tell to a conversation also prints a noisy 'Skipping tell intervention' line.
narratives.Proposal: Add one CLI-side resolver, src/cli/agent-target.ts, that parses explicit conversation forms (conv/<n>, conv:<n>, dashboard URLs), qualified agent IDs, bare numbers (issue agent vs conversation, refusing when both exist) and issue IDs into a discriminated result, plus one failure printer that lists every accepted form. A new listBareNumericIssueMatches export in issue-id.ts lets the resolver tell zero from multiple issue matches. tell, pause, unpause, untroubled and kill route through it; kill keeps its issue-wide fan-out for issue results. messaging.ts skips the intervention debug line for conv-* targets. Docs in cli/agent-commands.mdx and the pan-tell/pause/unpause/kill skills describe the forms.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to pan inbox, pan monitor or pan recover targeting
- No change to resolveAgentTarget, normalizeAgentId or any other code in src/lib/agents/identity.ts
- No change to dashboard routes, the /api/conversations/:id resolver, or conversation delivery
- No interactive picker for ambiguous targets; the command refuses and lists the choices
- No change to how pan kill fans an issue ID out to every agent of the issue
- No new environment variable or logger for debug output

autoDecisions.summary: Implement the resolver as a new CLI module src/cli/agent-target.ts and leave src/lib/agents/identity.ts untouched
autoDecisions.rationale: identity.ts is an import-cycle leaf and conversations.ts imports the dashboard event store; tell.ts already dynamic-imports conversations.ts for that reason, and a src/cli leaf cannot close a cycle.

autoDecisions.summary: A bare number counts a conversation candidate only when the row exists and origin is not 'vault'; archived and ended conversations count
autoDecisions.rationale: Vault rows are browse copies that cannot receive messages; archived rows still make the number ambiguous and the explicit forms always resolve it.

autoDecisions.summary: An issue candidate is any agent-*-<n> state dir with a matching state.json issueId, running or not (today's resolveBareNumericId rule); two or more issue candidates are also reported as ambiguous
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the existing issue meaning for bare numbers; distinguishing zero from many matches prevents silently picking a conversation when two projects share the number.

autoDecisions.summary: Include pan untroubled alongside tell, pause, unpause and kill/stop
autoDecisions.rationale: It carries the identical duplicated resolver call and error text; inbox, monitor and recover have different fallback semantics and stay out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Explicit conversation forms accept a conversation number (rowid) or a YYYYMMDD-NNNN name, matching the dashboard's resolveConversationKey rule
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard routes both /conv/<n> and /conv/<name>, and a pasted URL can carry either.

autoDecisions.summary: Silence the intervention-skip line only for conv-* IDs and keep the existing console.debug for other agents
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to keep it at debug level for issue agents with missing state; the existing test asserts that line.

items.title: Export listBareNumericIssueMatches from issue-id.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4465.md). Extract the digit-scan loop of resolveBareNumericId in src/lib/issue-id.ts into a new export listBareNumericIssueMatches(input, overdeckHome?) returning every matching issueId (deduplicated with a Set; [] for non-digit input or unreadable dir). Rewrite resolveBareNumericId's digit branch to return matches[0] when exactly one match, else null. Non-digit behavior (resolveIssueId) is unchanged. Add src/lib/__tests__/issue-id-bare-numeric-matches.test.ts with a mkdtemp overdeckHome fixture.

items.title: Given agent-pan-12 and agent-min-12 state dirs whose state.json issueIds are PAN-12 and MIN-12, listBareNumericIssueMatches('12', home) returns both issueIds
Given that same two-issue fixture, resolveBareNumericId('12', home) returns null, and given a one-issue fixture it returns that single issueId
listBareNumericIssueMatches('PAN-12', home) returns an empty array for non-digit input
Add the shared CLI agent-target resolver and failure printer

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 and Decisions 1-7 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4465.md). Create src/cli/agent-target.ts exporting AgentTargetResolution (agent | issue | ambiguous | unresolved), resolveCliAgentTarget(input), resolveCliSingleAgentId(input), printAgentTargetFailure(failure, verb) and ACCEPTED_TARGET_FORMS, with the exact parse order and regexes in the PRD. Import resolveAgentTarget/isQualifiedAgentId via ../lib/agents.js, listBareNumericIssueMatches/resolveIssueId via ../lib/issue-id.js, and load ../lib/overdeck/conversations.js only via dynamic import() inside try/catch. The conversation agent ID is row.tmuxSession; vault-origin rows never count. Do not modify src/lib/agents/identity.ts. Write src/cli/__tests__/agent-target.test.ts with every case listed in WI-2. Also do WI-2's mock prep: add listBareNumericIssueMatches and a conversations.js mock to the issue-id.js mock factories in bare-numeric-id-resolution.test.ts and kill.test.ts.
